concerns.text: FR‑004 in the spec requires Type I error estimation by shuffling group labels on real data, but the plan replaces this with simulated‑null datasets that preserve marginal shapes (see plan section “FR‑004 (amended) … generate simulated null datasets …”). The spec has not been amended, creating a contradiction between requirement and proposed method.

FR‑008 in the spec mandates a Friedman test (non‑parametric repeated‑measures ANOVA) for assessing transformation effects, yet the plan proposes using a binomial GLMM with Bonferroni‑corrected post‑hoc tests (see plan step 11). This methodological shift is not reflected in the specification.
